en: Colorized historical view of a European market square with cobblestone pavement. Children and adults stand or walk in the open plaza. In the center stands an equestrian statue on a high pedestal, surrounded by multi‑story townhouses with steep red roofs. At the back left a large baroque palace or castle rises on a hill. On the right side there is a church-like building and a tall advertising column covered with posters. A clock tower with a baroque dome is visible in the background. The printed caption at the top left reads 'Weißenfels. Markt.' in German-style lettering.
